$comment: Typecheck boundary for a standalone checkout of this package.
Both dsh peer packages and the dsh client UI packages resolve from npm
(devDependencies) — they are published alongside dsh itself, so no path
alias into a sibling dsh checkout is needed or wanted. The peer ranges in
package.json are the single source of truth for the dsh version line.
The runtime gets these packages from the host dsh installation via
peerDependencies; the devDependency copies exist for this type checker
and for the standalone test run.
